messages:
mira: FYI ran a quick smoke on the new staged-config rollout and noticed quota billing jump for /embed.edge even though the rollout was marked as preview. Strange.
oliver: preview should be shadow-only. Any logs or metrics?
mira: router log snippet:
```
router.apply cfg=cfg-2026-09 route=/embed.edge mode=preview
metrics.emit requests_total{route="/embed.edge",env="prod"} 128
```
Note: emitter didn't add preview=true.
pat: Ah, the exporter adds labels based on the local runtime config blob. If router.apply runs in a separate thread it may emit metrics before the preview flag is attached.
quinn: Is this the same race we saw with dynamic-cache flags last month?
mira: Similar but this time we saw billing-aligned aggregations count it. Billing queries are `sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (route)` so unlabeled preview traffic shows up.
deploy-bot: config-bot: started apply cfg-2026-09 to prod-staging at 1771234565 :rocket:
oliver: Short term mitigation: change quota aggregation to explicitly include only `preview!~"true|1"` or preferably `preview="false"`. But that will miss any unlabeled items so we need to treat unlabeled as unknown.
pat: Agreed. I propose a staged approach:
1) Make PromQL tolerant: `sum(rate(requests_total{preview!~"true|1"}[1m])) by (route)` to exclude labeled previews.
2) Add a temporary virtual label via recording rule that tags metrics by comparing `config_applied` metrics (more on that) so unlabeled preview isn't silently counted.
3) Fix exporter to set preview label atomically when apply acknowledged.
quinn: For 2) we can emit `config_applied{route,config_hash,mode}` from router on apply ack. Then a recording rule joins on route+hash to set `preview=true` for matching windows.
mira: Console UX note: when we change PromQL the console "effective quota" will show lower numbers for routes with preview traffic. That could confuse product owners. We should show a tooltip/legend explaining when preview-excluded numbers are displayed.
oliver: Also add a small "preview active" banner on top of route detail if any recent `config_applied{route,mode="preview"}` samples exist. quinn: I can prototype a faint orange overlay for preview series and a text banner.
pat: Operational guard: add an alert that pages when `sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (route) - sum(rate(requests_total{preview=~"true|1"}[1m])) by (route)` exceeds 5% of total for >3 minutes. That catches unlabeled shadow traffic quickly.
mira: Good. I'll open infra/metrics PR to change recording rules + temporary PromQL and infra/router PR to make label attach atomic. pat: I'll own the alert. quinn: I'll open the console ticket and include copy for the banner + the overlay. oliver: And I'll draft the small internal postmortem template so we record root cause & timeline.
deploy-bot: config-bot: created change request CR-9942 for cfg-2026-09 :white_check_mark:
mira: Thanks team, priority P2 but let's move fast since billing skew is visible to finance. :grimacing:
